definitions.explanation: Time that has already passed, as opposed to the present or future.

examples.japanese: {過去|かこ}を{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}る。
examples.english: To look back on the past.

examples.japanese: {過去|かこ}のことは{忘|わす}れよう。
{過去|かこ}{最高|さいこう}の{記録|きろく}です。

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- {過去|かこ}に (in the past)
- {過去|かこ}を{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}る (to look back on the past)
- {過去|かこ}{形|けい} (past tense - grammar term)

Contrast: {現在|げんざい} (present), {未来|みらい} (future)
